domain_symbols.ai_ml: machine learning and deep learning formulas
domain_symbols.symbolic: symbolic expressions used by this domain

rules.name: Empirical risk minimization
rules.input_form: loss l, hypothesis h, samples (x_i, y_i)_{i=1..n}
rules.operation: Estimate the best hypothesis by minimizing average loss on the training set.
examples: Squared loss yields least squares regression
counterexamples: Non-IID data violates standard generalization bounds
common_errors: Conflating training loss with population loss

rules.name: Softmax cross-entropy gradient
rules.operation: Compute the gradient of cross-entropy loss with respect to pre-softmax logits in closed form.
counterexamples: Computing softmax separately can cause numerical instability
common_errors: Not using log-sum-exp for numerical stability

rules.name: Backpropagation chain rule
rules.input_form: layered function f = f_L o ... o f_1, loss L
rules.operation: Apply the chain rule layer-by-layer in reverse to compute gradients with respect to all parameters.
common_errors: Failing to detach computation graph causes memory growth

rules.name: Adam optimizer update
rules.operation: Adaptive moment estimation maintains exponential averages of gradient and squared gradient for per-parameter learning rates.
counterexamples: AdamW decouples weight decay for better generalization
common_errors: Forgetting bias correction in early iterations

rules.name: Scaled dot-product attention
rules.input_form: queries Q, keys K, values V of dim d_k
preconditions: Q, K, V have matching sequence and feature dims
rules.operation: Compute attention weights as scaled dot products then mix values accordingly.
examples: Core operation in every Transformer block
common_errors: Omitting causal mask in autoregressive decoders

rules.name: Convolution output spatial size
rules.input_form: input size W, kernel k, stride s, padding p, dilation d
preconditions: W, k, s, p, d non-negative integers; s >= 1
rules.operation: Compute the output spatial dimension of a 1D/2D convolution layer.
counterexamples: Negative result indicates kernel larger than padded input
common_errors: Forgetting dilation factor in modern architectures

rules.name: Bellman optimality equation
rules.output_form: V*(s) = max_a sum_{s'} P(s'|s,a) [R(s,a,s') + gamma V*(s')]
rules.operation: Characterize the optimal value function as the unique fixed point of the Bellman operator.
examples: Value iteration converges geometrically with rate gamma
counterexamples: Partially observable MDPs need belief-state value functions
common_errors: Using gamma = 1 in non-episodic settings causes divergence

rules.name: Policy gradient theorem
rules.output_form: grad_theta J = E[ grad_theta log pi_theta(a|s) * Q^pi(s,a) ]
rules.operation: Express the policy performance gradient as an expectation, enabling stochastic gradient ascent.
examples: REINFORCE, A2C, PPO all derive from this identity
common_errors: Forgetting that subtracting a state-only baseline preserves unbiasedness

rules.name: Variational autoencoder ELBO
rules.input_form: data x, latent z, encoder q_phi, decoder p_theta
rules.output_form: log p(x) >= E_q[log p_theta(x|z)] - KL(q_phi(z|x) || p(z))
rules.operation: Lower-bound the marginal likelihood by reconstruction quality minus KL regularization.
counterexamples: Importance-weighted ELBO is a tighter bound
common_errors: Posterior collapse when decoder is too powerful

rules.name: Diffusion model forward process
rules.output_form: x_t = sqrt(alphabar_t) x_0 + sqrt(1 - alphabar_t) epsilon, epsilon ~ N(0,I)
rules.operation: Define the closed-form noising of a sample at step t for training denoising diffusion models.
examples: Used in DDPM/score-based models for image synthesis
counterexamples: Non-Gaussian noise needs different reverse parameterization
common_errors: Conflating alpha_t and alphabar_t in implementations

rules.name: VC dimension generalization bound
rules.input_form: hypothesis class H of VC dim d, n samples
rules.output_form: with prob >= 1-delta: R(h) <= Remp(h) + O(sqrt((d + log(1/delta))/n))
preconditions: IID samples; H has finite VC dimension
rules.operation: Bound the generalization gap uniformly over the hypothesis class.
examples: Linear classifiers in R^d have VC dim d+1
counterexamples: Neural nets often generalize despite huge VC dim - tighter Rademacher bounds needed
common_errors: Applying classical VC bounds to deep nets and getting vacuous results

rules.name: Neural tangent kernel limit
rules.input_form: infinitely wide neural network with NTK parameterization
rules.output_form: training dynamics equivalent to kernel regression with fixed NTK
preconditions: Width -> infinity, NTK parameterization, small learning rate
rules.operation: Linearize training around initialization to obtain kernel regression dynamics.
examples: Provides convergence and generalization analyses for overparameterized nets
counterexamples: Feature learning regime (mu-P) departs from the NTK limit
common_errors: Assuming NTK predicts finite-width feature learning
